result.text:
Bank of America now sees the Fed hiking at each of its next 3 meetings

BofA economists added a January 2027 hike to their call, on top of the December and March hikes they already expected

That would take the fed funds rate from 3.75%-4.00% today to a peak of 4.50%-4.75%

Their old call was 2 more hikes at a quarterly pace, topping out at 4.25%-4.50%

"After Oct CPI, the Fed looks further behind the curve on inflation," BofA economist Aditya Bhave wrote, adding that the Fed "no longer has the luxury of hiking at a quarterly pace"

BofA now tracks core PCE, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, at 3.3% a year

The call lands the same morning wholesale prices hit +6.5% YoY, the hottest reading since 2022

When one of the biggest bank desks pencils in back to back hikes, the rate cut crowd has officially run out of road. Long duration tech in $QQQ and bonds in $TLT feel that first, and nobody should be surprised if a 5% fed funds rate is the next number the market starts to price
